newsitem.title: UK: Select details lower price, size of US offer.
newsitem.headline: Select details lower price, size of US offer.

text.p: British-based recruitment company Select Appointments Plc said on Monday it had curbed its original plans for a US public offering of new shares in response to adverse market sentiment in the US.

The new offering price is anticipated between $11.00 and $12.50 per ADS against the originally planned $13.50 to $15.50, while the amount to be offered was anticipated at three million ADSs against 5.2 million as planned before, the company said in a statement.

"This adjustment was largely in response to a recent announcement by a major US group of reduced earnings expectations, mainly attributable to margin pressures on major contracts," the statement said.
The final details of the US public offering are expected to be announced shortly, it said.
